targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.asset == "ur5" and r.metric == "position")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "joint"])

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.asset == "ur5" and r.metric == "velocity")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "joint"])
